title: Builds, Types, and Control Flow Phase Assessment
description: Comprehensive phase-end assessment covering all lessons in Builds, Types, and Control Flow.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of C++20 mode?

options.text: compile with std=c++20 consistently
the language mode selects modern standard rules
compiler defaults may use an older standard
The compiler automatically repairs the design

questions.explanation: compile with std=c++20 consistently. Confirm with a minimal C++20 program, strict warnings, and tests.
questions.recommendedLessonTitle: Compiling Modern C++ and Reading Diagnostics

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of warnings?

options.text: enable Wall Wextra and Wpedantic
warnings expose suspicious translated code
warning-free does not prove logic correctness
The compiler automatically repairs the design

questions.explanation: enable Wall Wextra and Wpedantic. Confirm with a minimal C++20 program, strict warnings, and tests.
questions.recommendedLessonTitle: Compiling Modern C++ and Reading Diagnostics
